metadata.title: Industrial Hydraulic Rescue Tool on Shag Carpet

retrievalProfile.description: A heavy industrial hydraulic spreader tool resting on a textured shag carpet with a moody, olive-tinted cinematic lighting style.
excludeWhen: requesting tools in a workshop setting

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key photograph of a mechanical hydraulic rescue tool (spreader) featuring knurled handles, circular cutouts, and a cylindrical motor housing, placed diagonally on a thick, textured shag rug under a heavy green-tinted color grade.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between cold, hard industrial metal and soft, organic carpet texture
Diagonal composition leading from the tool's pointed tip to the heavy motor base
Monochromatic olive-green color cast unifying the disparate materials
coreInvariants: Knurled texture on the horizontal and vertical handles
Circular weight-reduction holes in the spreader arms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The tool is the central subject, oriented diagonally from bottom-left to top-right, occupying approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, heavy cylindrical motor housing at the top-right provides the visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the sharp point at the bottom-left up the length of the spreader arms to the complex handle and motor assembly.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The surrounding shag carpet provides a uniform, textured negative space that isolates the tool.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted metallic grey (reflections on the spreader arms)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a heavy green tint; value range is compressed toward the dark end.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail photograph of a heavy hydraulic rescue spreader tool with knurled handles and circular cutouts on a thick shag carpet. Apply a low-key, cinematic lighting setup with a strong olive-green color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: No typography required for this composition.

verificationChecks: Ensure the carpet texture is visible and soft
Check for the specific knurled texture on the handles
Verify the olive-green tint is consistent across the frame

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the green color cast
Amount of wear/scuffing on the metal

mustAchieve: Tactile contrast between metal and fabric

postGenerationChecks: Does the tool look heavy and metallic?
Is the shag carpet texture distinct?
Is the lighting low-key with deep shadows?
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial object + soft domestic texture + low-key cinematic lighting + monochromatic tint.
